text.p: German world number one Steffi Graf made a shock fourth-round exit from the Australian Open on Sunday, beaten in straight sets by South Africa's Amanda Coetzer.
The South African, seeded 12th, beat Graf 6-2 7-5 in the biggest upset to date in the women's side of the draw.
The in-form South African broke Graf's first two service games and held on to take the first set 6-2.
Graf, who has won her last six grand slams but has been a hesitant starter this week, came back in the second set to build up a 4-0 lead.
But she wilted in the sun, allowing Coetzer to come back and produce the best performance of her career to wrap up the match in 98 minutes on a stunned centre court.
It was Graf's worst result in Melbourne since she lost in the third round as a 14-year-old in 1984.
